title: hemigymnia arnottiana
intro: Hemigymnia arnottiana, commonly known as the "Malaysian liverwort", is a species of liverwort that belongs to the family Hemigymniaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Southeast Asia for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving liver function. The therapeutic actions of Hemigymnia arnottiana include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and hepatoprotective effects, making it a potential treatment for liver diseases and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
